name: yila
description: Draw scientific figures with Yila and edit them on the Yila canvas beside the conversation. Literature tools are coming soon.

interface.shortDescription: Your research workbench and figure canvas, inside your agent.
interface.longDescription: Yila draws publication-quality scientific figures (graphical abstracts, mechanism diagrams, workflows) from the outline your agent writes, saves them in your Yila project, and opens the editable Yila canvas in the host's built-in browser. Paste an advisor's or reviewer's comments to get a new version next to the old one. Uses your Yila account and credits; no API key. Literature search, reading and reference tools are coming soon.
defaultPrompt: Connect to Yila, call yila_get_orientation, and introduce what Yila can do in my language.
